result.title: What Words Keep of a Place: Zero-Shot Language Reasoning for Cross-View Geo-Localization
result.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop Physical World AI: Geometry, Characteristics, and Multimodal Sensing
result.summary: Cross-view geo-localization is commonly solved as an image retrieval problem, matching a ground-level image against a database of satellite tiles through a jointly trained embedding. Such models are accurate, but they need large paired supervision and cannot show what evidence supports a match. In this paper, we study a different question: how much of this task can be solved through language alone? We prompt a multimodal large language model (MLLM) to describe each ground panorama and each satellite tile as structured text, and localize by comparing these descriptions. No component is trained. We evaluate on 9,826 VIGOR pairs from four U.S. cities, in three settings. First, the descriptions are faithful but not discriminative. They agree closely across the two views, yet ranking the full pool by description similarity almost never returns the correct tile (0.39% Recall@1). Second, we narrow the pool to ten neighboring tiles, as a coarse prior would do. The same descriptions now become useful: an MLLM judge that scores structural consistency doubles random ranking and matches a strong lexical baseline. It also states which fields of the two descriptions agree and which conflict, which an embedding distance cannot do, and which we see as a step toward interpretable localization. Third, we place the judge on a trained visual retriever. On the queries it ranks wrongly, reranking from images works, while reranking from our descriptions does not (23.5% against 10.7% Recall@1). Scene structure survives the conversion into language, while the fine appearance detail needed to separate nearby places does not. Code and prompts are publicly available at https://github.com/AyeshAbuLehyeh/GeoLingual.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文不给任何模块训练，用 MLLM 把地面全景和卫星瓦片分别转成结构化文本描述，再借文本相似度或 MLLM 判别来做跨视角地理定位，并在 VIGOR 的 9,826 对数据上比较全库检索、缩小候选池、以及在训练好的视觉检索器上重排三种设置。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接关系到「语言/内部表示能否保留视觉证据」：其发现——场景结构可经语言保真传递，但区分邻近地点的细粒度外观信息在下游定位中几乎丢失（0.39% vs 受限池内有效、重排 23.5% vs 10.7%）——为判断 latent 状态中的视觉细节是否被语言化瓶颈吞掉提供了具体诊断线索，也涉及证据筛选与可解释的停止/匹配依据。
